Subject: Vendor docs for activation — COI, W9, cyber supplement

Hi Olga / Dylan,

Per our intake call earlier this week, please find the initial vendor package attached so we can move Novaplace onto your procurement system. Attached: COI (current), W9, cyber liability supplement, and our subcontractor list.

A couple quick notes:
- Policy is active through 2029-06-30; limits shown for GL and professional liability.
- Cyber supplement lists incident contact and retroactive date.
- If you need an endorsement naming Redwood Inference as Additional Insured we can request that from our broker, but it takes 3–5 business days to issue.

Can you confirm what endorsement language you require and whether the PO needs to be issued before we invoice? Our billing team typically requires a PO number.

Thanks,

Alex Rivera
Director, Procurement Operations
Novaplace Technologies
procure@novaplace.com

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2028 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor docs for activation — COI, W9, cyber supplement

Alex — thanks for sending these over.  Quick checklist and next steps from procurement/risk:  

1) Certificate of Insurance (COI) — acceptable start, but we need an endorsement with the following items:
   - Redwood Inference, Inc. listed as Additional Insured (CG 20 10 or equivalent)
   - Waiver of Subrogation in favor of Redwood Inference, Inc.
   - Primary and Non‑Contributory wording for General Liability and Auto
   - 30 days' notice of cancellation

2) Cyber/Privacy coverage — minimum limits we require are $2M per claim / $2M aggregate for vendors processing sensitive data. Please confirm retroactive date and that the policy includes breach response costs. If the supplement shows lower limits, an endorsement or proof of excess coverage will be needed.

3) W9 — thanks, procurement will keep this on file.

4) Subcontractor list — please confirm whether any subcontractors will have access to customer data; if so, attach their COIs or indicate that Novaplace will add Redwood as Additional Insured on their subcontractor policies.

5) PO timing & invoicing — Our standard is to issue a conditional PO once we have: signed SOW + evidence of requested endorsements. Final PO (and invoice payment) will follow within 5 business days of endorsement receipt. If you need the PO earlier for billing, explain and we'll review exception.

If you can ask your broker to send an endorsement with exact wording (see below) that will help speed review. We can accept an emailed PDF from the broker.

Required endorsement language (sample):
"Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors, and employees are named as Additional Insured on a primary and non‑contributory basis for ongoing and completed operations. Waiver of subrogation applies in favor of Redwood Inference, Inc. Thirty (30) days' notice of cancellation to be provided to certificate holder."

Action items: 1) Novaplace to request endorsement from broker (3–5 business days typical). 2) If endorsement timing is a blocker, let us know and procurement will evaluate a short-term conditional activation with restricted privileges.

I'll loop in Michael from finance to confirm PO processing rules.

Best,

Olga Petrov
Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
ole: +1 415 555 0192
Attachment stubs referenced: endorsement-request-form.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novaplace.com>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2028 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor docs for activation — COI, W9, cyber supplement

Olga / team — thanks, we can route this to our broker today. A few clarifications:

- We can request the Additional Insured endorsement and Waiver of Subrogation. Broker estimates 72 hours to issue once requested.
- Cyber limits on the supplement are currently $1M each / $1M aggregate; we do have an excess policy that can be combined to meet $2M — I'll attach a short certificate for the excess policy tonight.
- Subcontractors: two small subcontractors will touch non‑sensitive telemetry only; neither accesses PII. We'll include their names and attest that they do not handle customer data. If you require COIs for them, we can obtain those as well.

Regarding PO: our billing group prefers a PO number prior to issuing the first invoice, but we've invoiced on a provisional basis before if a conditional PO is provided. If Redwood can provide a conditional PO that references "activation pending endorsement" we can accept that and queue the invoice.

I've attached an endorsement request form filled with Novaplace broker contact details; let me know if you want us to copy Redwood's broker contact in the request.

—Alex
